title: Turn it off from the message: signed links, a page and one-click unsubscribe
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** As a recipient, every message lets me stop this kind, mute this incident or stop everything, without signing in. This is package logic; hosts serve the pages.

**Build.**
- `manage.py`, `handlers/public.py`: tokens per Papyrus `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/tokens.py`, key given by the host, no address in a link. GET shows a button and changes nothing, because mail scanners fetch links. POST acts. RFC 8058 `List-Unsubscribe` and `List-Unsubscribe-Post` on every message that is not a one-off to one person.
- Hosts: operator mail uses a function URL (PPY-3e260c). Site mail uses real pages of the site (PPY-f361ee), with `/api/notifications/*` as the machine endpoints.

**Acceptance.**
Behave features plus a test that GET changes no state. Ryan's screenshot approval is on the Papyrus pages.

**Depends on:** kanbus-222bcf, kanbus-cfe4b9
**Related:** PPY-3e260c, PPY-f361ee

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Turning off from a message
  Scenario: A mail scanner follows the link
    When the manage link is fetched with GET
    Then nothing changes

  Scenario: One click
    When a mail provider posts the one-click unsubscribe for a kind
    Then that person gets no more of that kind and the answer is 200

  Scenario: Muting one incident
    Given an open incident
    When an operator presses "Mute this incident"
    Then they get no clearing message for it and other incidents still reach them
```
